Subject: Whistic profile — temporary presign window and minimal evidence handoff

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call earlier. We're working to push BrightLeaf's Whistic profile live so our SOC 2 + SIG snapshot can be visible to your security reviewers. Two small asks from our side:

1) We need a short presign window for three S3 objects (logs and an exported QnA bundle). Can Redwood accept presigned URLs that expire within 72 hours? We typically do 48–72h.
2) To speed review, can you confirm the minimum set of evidence Redwood needs to mark the profile as "provisionally verified"? Our suggested payload: SOC2 summary PDF (control mappings), exported CAIQ answers (CSV), and one signed policy doc.

Attached is a trimmed export and a tiny presign proof text file that shows the intended object keys.

If there's anything else required (e.g., specific field formatting or a canonical manifest), tell us and we'll adjust. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks —
Emily
Emily Cho
Security Operations, BrightLeaf
attachments: brightleaf_whistic_export.csv (text/csv), s3-presign-proof.txt (text/plain)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.example>

Subject: Re: Whistic profile — temporary presign window and minimal evidence handoff

Emily —

Thanks for the export. A couple quick clarifications so we can avoid follow-ups from our reviewers:

- Presign window: 48–72h is fine. Our ingestion job will consume any objects within that window. Please include a short SHA256 checksum file alongside each object (we only need a 64-hex checksum string in a .sha256 file).

- Minimal evidence: for a provisional verification we ask for: (a) SOC 2 executive summary PDF with a date + auditor name, (b) CAIQ export CSV with field headers intact, (c) one representative policy (e.g., Data Retention or Incident Response) in PDF/HTML. If the export includes a control mappings sheet that’s great but not required.

- Filename conventions: please avoid spaces and use lowercase hyphens (e.g., soc2-summary-2026.pdf).

Irene will own the ingestion and validation; Soojin will own the Whistic profile metadata update. Emily, can you confirm the presign start time and whether the SHA256 files will be present? If you can include a short manifest (manifest.json ok) pointing to keys, that’ll speed ingestion.

Cheers,
Markus
VP, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
